feeds.title: That Goan Girl » Food
feeds.description: The Food section of That Goan Girl offers authentic, in-depth restaurant reviews, curated lists, and local food guides—primarily across Goa, with occasional coverage of other Indian cities. From coastal coastal cuisine in Anjuna to street food in Mumbai, Jade's honest insights help food lovers discover new favorites and hidden gems.

feeds.title: Goan Home Cooked Recipes
feeds.description: Goan home-cooked recipes are an intrinsic part of authentic food culture in Goan homes. Rice, Seafood, Coconut, and local spices are the main ingredients of goa. Browse through the delicious and authentic Goan recipes in the blog.

feeds.title: Incredible Goa Food and Hospitality
feeds.description: Incredible Goa Food & Hospitality is Goa's First Online Food & Hospitality Magazine that promotes the stories most relevant to the Food & Hospitality industry in Goa. It will bring you the latest news, views, and updates pertaining to this industry.

feeds.title: Delicious memories with Alves Fernandes
feeds.description: Over the years through my profession, I have been introduced to a lot of cuisines from different parts of the world. I am a foodie and there is no doubt about it. My love for food in my earlier days motivated me to pursue a career in the food industry. Join me as I unfold my delicious memories of food with you starting with Authentic Goan cuisine. Explore my goan recipes and food articles.

feeds.title: Goan Cuisine Au Blog
feeds.description: We are a family-owned, proud Australian company, showcasing the best of Goan Cuisine. Established in 1994, Goan Cuisine is a high-quality food manufacturing business promoting the cuisine of Goa in Australia and internationally. For every product we develop, we preserve traditional artisanal skills and knowledge that would otherwise be lost. Using the very best of Australian fresh produce, we employ time-honored methods fine-tuned to meet Australian and international food manufacturing standards.

feeds.title: ItsGoa » Food
feeds.description: Explore all the food and delicacies found in Goa and Goan culture. ItsGoa was started in 2015, with the aim of becoming the premier portal for all things Goa. Today with thousands of visitors a month from across the world, our blog based website has transcended the virtual space, with the ItsGoa magazine - a sought after resource for visitors to Goa. We bring you all the information needed to paddle your way through the beautiful paradise we call Goa!
